_comment: Maps the portal's read operations to tools on your Zoho MCP server. Tool names and argument shapes depend on the server you create in Zoho CRM (Setup > Developer Hub > MCP for AI Agents). The values below are placeholders: run `python -m app.cli mcp-check --schemas` to list your server's real tools and their input schemas, then edit this file. {query}, {id} and {module} are filled in by the portal. Only coql is required; remove getUser or getFields if your server does not offer them.
